PLAN YOUR RETREAT AT THE BEACH
HERE’S WHY GUESTS COME BACK YEAR AFTER YEAR
Plan Your Retreat
OUR VALUES
ROOTED IN FAITH

In Matthew 22:37-39, Jesus said, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself.”  

We believe that our retreat offers a place where these two commandments can be explored, understood, and put into practice.

We have faced oil spills, hurricanes, and economic downturns, but God has been faithful through every difficulty. 

We’re honored to be part of the retreat’s history and to open our doors to groups of all kinds. 

Our goal is to provide a safe, exclusive space where your group can strengthen their relationships with each other, all while having fun, learning, and growing as individuals.

WHAT SETS US APART FROM OTHER EMERALD COAST RETREATS?
WE HAVE EVERYTHING YOU NEED!

Sure, you can leave the retreat for off-site adventures, but you don’t have to!

Each side of the retreat has private access to its own:

Full commercial kitchen

Private pool with large deck area

Sand volleyball court

Basketball goal

Charcoal grills

Being able to stay on-site helps you focus more time and energy on bonding and strengthening relationships, which is the true magic of our retreat.

YES, OUR RETREAT IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOUR GROUP!

 We regularly host:

Church groups (youth and adult)

Sports teams

School field trips

Women’s and men’s groups

Scouts, and more!

PLANNING FOR A CHURCH GROUP?
Learn More
PLANNING FOR A SPORTS TEAM?
Learn More
PLANNING A MARINE SCIENCE FIELD TRIP?
Learn More
PERFECT FOR EVERY GROUP
COMMON CHALLENGES WHEN PLANNING A GETAWAY
AND HOW OUR RETREAT SOLVES THEM

Planning is easy because we have everything you need in one place. Just make a reservation and get your group here! We take care of the rest.

MANAGING TRIP LOGISTICS

Groups have exclusive access to their side of the resort. We also go above and beyond to keep the resort clean so your group stays healthy.

MAINTAINING YOUTH SAFETY

Between the beach, on-site amenities, and entertainment, your group will have no shortage of ways to make memories during your downtime.

PROVIDING ENTERTAINMENT
DISCONNECTING & RECONNECTING

Our resort is ideal for disconnecting from cellphones and social media and making genuine connections among participants and group leaders.

YOUR HEALTH & SAFETY ARE TOP PRIORITIES

When you plan your retreat with us, you can feel confident that your group will be safe and healthy. 

We use enhanced cleaning procedures and have hand sanitizing stations throughout the facility. 

We’ve also installed the REME HALO In-Duct Purifier. The system kills SARS-CoV-2 (Virus causing COVID-19), is used by hospitals and military installations, and vastly improves indoor air quality. This system kills up to 99% of bacteria, mold, and viruses, and reduces airborne particulates.

GUESTS COME BACK TO OUR RESORT AGAIN & AGAIN

HERE’S WHY

“THIS IS MY 2ND TIME VISITING. [THE MARINE SCIENCES TRIP] IS A STELLAR FIELD TRIP, SUGGESTED FOR ANYONE WHO GETS THE CHANCE. DR. SIMPSON MAKES SURE TO GIVE A GOOD VALUE. LEARNED A LOT. STORM CAME IN ON OUR SECOND TRIP, SO HE CHANGED UP THE CURRICULUM SO THAT WE WOULD STILL LEARN A LOT.”

— Tasha M.

“THE PRIVACY THAT THE RETREAT OFFERS WAS PERFECT FOR OUR GROUP. IT PROVIDED AN INTIMATE SETTING THAT ALLOWED OUR TEENS TO GROW TOGETHER AS THEY GREW THEIR RELATIONSHIPS WITH GOD. WE CAN’T WAIT FOR OUR NEXT VISIT TO GULF SHORES BEACH RETREAT. IT TRULY WAS PERFECT.”

— Chris C., Youth Pastor

“I’VE BEEN BRINGING GROUPS TO THE GULF SHORES BEACH RETREAT SINCE 1999. IT’S SIMPLY ONE OF THE BEST PLACES FOR PEOPLE TO COME ENJOY A GREAT TIME AND CONNECT WITH EACH OTHER AND WITH GOD! THE RETREAT CENTER AND STAFF ARE TOP NOTCH AND THE CHANCE TO WORSHIP AND EXPERIENCE GOD AT THE BEACH IS UNPARALLELED. IT’S TRULY A ONE-OF-A-KIND PLACE TO BRING YOUR CHURCH.”

— Drew H., Youth Pastor

“I CAN’T SAY ENOUGH ABOUT THIS WONDERFUL PLACE. I HAVE VISITED HERE MANY TIMES WITH OUR YOUTH GROUP AND OTHER YOUTH GROUPS. IF YOU ARE PLANNING A RETREAT, YOU WOULD SERVE YOURSELF WELL TO CHECK WITH THEM FIRST. REASONABLE PRICES, A GREAT LOCATION, AND MANY WONDERFUL FACILITIES. LOVE IT!!!”

— Ray R.

“GULF SHORES BEACH RETREAT PROVIDES AN EXCELLENT ATMOSPHERE FOR A YOUTH RETREAT. OUR RETREAT THERE IS THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR SUMMER. THE FACILITIES ARE PERFECT FOR YOUTH GROUPS AND THE EASY BEACH ACCESS IS CONVENIENT. WE HAVE BEEN COMING FOR SIX YEARS AND PLAN TO CONTINUE USING THEM FOR MANY MORE.”

— Avery J., Youth Pastor

TOUR THE RETREAT!
GET THE LAY OF THE LAND BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

Want to know more about our retreat?

Plan Your Retreat

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ABOUT THE RETREAT

WHAT TYPES OF GROUPS STAY AT YOUR RETREAT?

We host church groups, sports teams, scouts, school field trips, men’s and women’s groups, and many more.

CAN WE SCHEDULE A TOUR OF THE RETREAT?

Yes, we would be happy to give you a tour. Please email to set up a time. We are also happy to email you pictures and videos.

DO WE SHARE A POOL OR OTHER AMENITIES WITH ANOTHER GROUP?

No! You will have your own private pool with quality lounge chairs, sand volleyball, basketball, parking, charcoal grills, and kitchen. You have exclusive access to your side of the resort, meaning no unauthorized persons will be in your space.

WHAT’S SOMETHING THAT SETS GULF SHORES BEACH RETREAT APART FROM OTHER EMERALD COAST RESORTS?

We offer exclusivity: nobody else will be on your side of the retreat. Nobody else will be in your rooms, your kitchen, at your pool, or around your kids. When you stay with us you make your retreat side your home away from home.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS AT THE BEACH
LEARN AND GROW TOGETHER ON THE EMERALD COAST.

TAKE YOUR STUDENTS ON AN ADVENTURE

WHAT SETS OUR MARINE SCIENCE ADVENTURES APART?
LEARN & PLAY AT THE BEACH

Providing hands-on learning experiences for your students takes a ton of work, but you don’t have to do the work alone!

Students collect nearly 100 different species with collection tools like seines, slurp guns, and plankton nets. They also get an incredible sea turtle experience and a guided exploration of the beach at night.

Our Marine Science Adventures cover a range of sciences as your students explore the diverse ecosystems of our local marine environment. We explore tidal pools, salt-water marshes, estuaries, bays, the gulf, dunes, maritime forests, and the lagoon.

All of the adventures meet Alabama State Science Standards and use STEM, STEAM, and STREAM-based learning methods.

THE BEST PART? TEACHERS AND CHAPERONES GET TO EXPERIENCE THE WONDERS OF THE BEACH ECOSYSTEMS RIGHT ALONGSIDE THEIR STUDENTS! 
IS IT REALLY WORTH DUMPING ALL OF THAT SAND OUT OF YOUR SHOES?
WE THINK SO! HERE’S WHY.
HANDS-ON LEARNING

Give your students hands-on experiences that lead to a deeper understanding of the subject matter, plus create fun, lifelong memories.

TIED TO SCIENCE STANDARDS

The adventure is a blast AND it’s guided by State Science Standards so you can feel confident that it’s a worthwhile use of classroom time.

SAFE & SUPERVISED

OUR STORY
WHAT MADE US THE RETREAT WE ARE TODAY

Hurricanes Ivan (2004) and Katrina (2005) left The Gulf Shores Beach Retreat abandoned, partially destroyed, and decaying for several years. It had open holes in the roof and the lower floor was destroyed and filled with hurricane debris, but God was not done with this place. 

It took about 4 months of work to reopen the retreat in time for the summer of 2007, and the retreat immediately bore fruit. Groups who had previously stayed here returned, and new groups came in. 

We have faced oil spills, hurricanes, and economic downturns, but God has been faithful through every difficulty. 

In Matthew 22:37-39, Jesus said, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself.”  

We believe that our retreat offers a place where these two commandments can be explored, understood, and put into practice.

We’re honored to be part of the retreat’s history and to open our doors to groups of all kinds.

HOW WE CREATE AMAZING GETAWAYS
HELPING YOUR CREW BOND

Our goal is to provide an awesome trip that inspires your group to learn, connect, and build relationships.

We achieve this by offering a fun and safe environment where you can disconnect from technology (at least a bit) and connect face-to-face. Between our facility amenities and location on the Gulf of Mexico, you’ll have everything you need to make your retreat memorable.

WHAT SETS OUR RESORT APART?
YOU CAN FOCUS ON BUILDING RELATIONSHIPS & WORSHIP


The last thing you want to do on a retreat is worry.

Worry about the health and safety of your group.

Worry if they’ll be entertained.

Worry if you’ll achieve your goals for the trip.

Worry if you’ll have access to the spaces you need for worship and breakout groups.

We take all the worries out of your retreat. We have everything you need to achieve the outcomes you hope for. All you need to do is figure out how to get your group here. We’ll take care of the rest!

IS IT REALLY WORTH DEALING WITH ALL THAT SAND IN YOUR LUGGAGE?
WE THINK SO. HERE’S WHY.
SPACE FOR ALL YOUR NEEDS

In addition to spacious sleeping arrangements, we also have a great worship space, a place for your band, small group areas, and places to relax.

We have all the entertainment you need on-site so you can focus on your trip goals rather than complicated logistics for off-site excursions.

FOCUS ON YOUR TRIP GOALS
COME BACK FIRED UP

Your group will come back to your church fired up and will spread their energy and the Word throughout your congregation and beyond.

Select Your Preferred Travel Dates

Wireless internet

1,600 square foot shared worship space

Full commercial kitchen

4 bunk rooms 

2 staff rooms

Boardwalk directly onto the beach

Private pool with large deck area

Sand volleyball court

2 charcoal grills

Parking for buses, vans, or cars

OUR STORY
WHAT MADE US THE RETREAT WE ARE TODAY

Hurricanes Ivan (2004) and Katrina (2005) left The Gulf Shores Beach Retreat abandoned, partially destroyed, and decaying for several years. It had open holes in the roof and the lower floor was destroyed and filled with hurricane debris, but God was not done with this place. 

It took about 4 months of work to reopen the retreat in time for the summer of 2007, and the retreat immediately bore fruit. Groups who had previously stayed here returned, and new groups came in. 

We have faced oil spills, hurricanes, and economic downturns, but God has been faithful through every difficulty. 

In Matthew 22:37-39, Jesus said, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself.”  

We believe that our retreat offers a place where these two commandments can be explored, understood, and put into practice.

We’re honored to be part of the retreat’s history and to open our doors to groups of all kinds.

HOW WE CREATE AMAZING GETAWAYS
HELPING YOUR CREW BOND

Our goal is to provide an awesome trip that inspires your group to learn, connect, and build relationships.

We achieve this by offering a fun and safe environment where you can disconnect from technology (at least a bit) and connect face-to-face. Between our facility amenities and location on the Gulf of Mexico, you’ll have everything you need to make your retreat memorable.
